roadmap.title: Finish the base story
roadmap.description: Complete all three acts on any difficulty while opening towers and nearby activities.

roadmap.title: Reach 100% and clean up
roadmap.description: Clear all nine districts, Taskmaster challenges, side missions, collectibles, suits, gadgets, and miscellaneous counters.

roadmap.title: Combine New Game+ with Ultimate
roadmap.description: Create New Game+ on Ultimate difficulty and replay the main story to satisfy both campaign achievements.

roadmap.title: Complete The Heist
roadmap.description: Finish its story, artworks, crimes, and Screwball challenges.

roadmap.title: Complete Turf Wars
roadmap.description: Finish its story, crimes, Hammerhead Fronts, Screwball challenges, and finale.

roadmap.title: Complete Silver Lining
roadmap.description: Finish its story, crimes, Olympus Hideouts, tapes, Screwball challenges, and follow-ups.

achievements.description: Unlock all Skills
achievements.summary: Purchase every skill in all three skill trees after earning enough skill points through level 50.

guide.context: Normal leveling stops at level 50, which supplies the points for every base skill. Story missions, side missions, bases, and collectibles all award the XP needed.

steps.text: Complete story missions and map activities until Spider-Man reaches level 50 and has earned every available skill point.
Open Skills and spend the points on every remaining node in all three trees.

achievements.description: 100% complete all districts
achievements.summary: Reach 100% completion in all nine @loc{Manhattan} districts by finishing every required story, side activity, collectible, base, and faction crime.

guide.context: Base-game completion spans nine districts and 358 map activities. Activate every @mechanic{Surveillance Tower} first; crimes appear dynamically while traversing.

steps.text: Open the relevant campaign map and inspect every district or episode completion category.
Reach 100% completion in all nine @loc{Manhattan} districts by finishing every required story, side activity, collectible, base, and faction crime.
Complete the final unchecked activity and remain in the campaign until its completion percentage updates to 100%.

achievements.description: Defeat Taskmaster after completing all 16 Taskmaster Challenges
achievements.summary: Defeat @npc{Taskmaster} after completing all 16 @mechanic{Taskmaster Challenges}.

guide.context: @npc{Taskmaster} first attacks after five completed challenges and returns after all 16. The achievement is awarded for winning the second encounter.

steps.text: Complete any five @mechanic{Taskmaster Challenges} to trigger and win the first @npc{Taskmaster} ambush.
Complete all 16 Bomb, Combat, Stealth, and Drone challenges at any rating.
Travel after the final challenge until @npc{Taskmaster} attacks again, then defeat him in the rematch.

achievements.description: Collect all Backpacks
achievements.summary: Collect all 55 @item{backpacks} shown after activating each district's @mechanic{Surveillance Towers}.

guide.context: Activating a district's @mechanic{Surveillance Towers} reveals its @item{backpack} icons. Mark an icon and use the scanner when nearby to pinpoint the pickup.

steps.text: Activate the relevant @mechanic{Surveillance Towers} to reveal the collection icons on the map.
Collect all 55 @item{backpacks} shown after activating each district's @mechanic{Surveillance Towers}.
Open the district map and confirm that the stated collection total has been recorded.

achievements.description: Track down Black Cat
achievements.summary: Complete all 12 @npc{Black Cat} Stakeouts, then investigate her hideout.

guide.context: Each completed stakeout reveals part of @npc{Black Cat}'s trail. After the twelfth, a new hideout objective appears and must also be investigated.

steps.text: Advance the base story and activate the @mechanic{Surveillance Towers} to reveal every @npc{Black Cat} Stakeout.
Complete all 12 stakeout camera searches.
Follow the objective created by the twelfth stakeout and investigate @npc{Black Cat}'s hideout.

achievements.description: Take down every Demon Warehouse
achievements.summary: Clear all five @mechanic{Demon Warehouses}.

guide.context: @mechanic{Demon Warehouses} unlock as the Demons enter the story. Their optional base objectives are not required for this achievement.

steps.text: Select each uncleared red Demon-mask Warehouse icon on the base-game map.
Defeat every enemy wave in all five @mechanic{Demon Warehouses}; their optional objectives may be ignored.
Remain in each warehouse until its icon records the completed state.

achievements.description: Take down every Fisk Hideout
achievements.summary: Clear all six @mechanic{Fisk Hideouts}.

guide.context: @mechanic{Fisk Hideouts} are the earliest and easiest enemy bases. Clear every enemy wave; the two optional objectives are irrelevant here.

steps.text: Select each uncleared @mechanic{Fisk Hideout} icon on the base-game map.
Defeat every enemy wave in all six @mechanic{Fisk Hideouts}; their optional objectives may be ignored.
Remain in each hideout until its icon records the completed state.

achievements.description: Take down every Sable Outpost
achievements.summary: Clear all four @mechanic{Sable Outposts}.

guide.context: @mechanic{Sable Outposts} unlock late in the story and contain snipers and heavily equipped enemies. Optional objectives are not required.

steps.text: Select each uncleared @mechanic{Sable Outpost} icon after those bases unlock late in the base story.
Remove the snipers first, then defeat every wave in all four @mechanic{Sable Outposts}.
Remain in each outpost until its map icon records the completed state.

achievements.description: Take down every Prisoner Camp
achievements.summary: Clear all four @mechanic{Prisoner Camps}.

guide.context: @mechanic{Prisoner Camps} become available during Act 3. Clear every enemy wave at each pink barbed-wire map icon.

steps.text: During or after Act 3, select each pink barbed-wire @mechanic{Prisoner Camp} icon.
Defeat every enemy wave in all four @mechanic{Prisoner Camps}.
Remain in each camp until its map icon records the completed state.

achievements.description: Complete all Faction Crimes in a district
achievements.summary: Complete every base-game faction crime listed for one @loc{Manhattan} district.

guide.context: Crimes are dynamic rather than fixed map icons. Hover over a district to see the unfinished faction counters, then swing there and scan for red crime alerts.

steps.text: Choose a district with an unfinished crime counter, then swing through it while repeatedly scanning for red crime alerts.
Complete every base-game faction crime listed for one @loc{Manhattan} district.
Hover over the district and confirm that the relevant crime or takedown counter has reached its target.

achievements.description: Purchase all Suits
achievements.summary: Purchase all 23 suits required by the base-game suit collection.

guide.context: Only the 23 purchasable base suits are required. Undies, Homemade, Anti-Ock, and Dark Suit are reward unlocks and do not count toward the purchase requirement.

steps.text: Complete story missions, collectibles, bases, crimes, and challenges to unlock the 23 purchasable suits and earn their required tokens.
Open Suits and buy every required suit; Undies, Homemade, Anti-Ock, and Dark Suit may remain unpurchased.

achievements.description: Complete every Corrupted Student side mission
achievements.summary: Complete @npc{Philip Chang}'s five @mechanic{Corrupted Student side missions} at @loc{ESU} in @loc{Greenwich}.

guide.context: The chain begins after Spider-Hack in Act 2. @npc{Philip Chang} gives all five missions at @loc{ESU}, and each completed photo investigation unlocks the next.

steps.text: After completing Spider-Hack in Act 2, visit @npc{Philip Chang} at @loc{ESU} in @loc{Greenwich} and start College Buddies.
Use each photo and Spider-Man's hints to locate the missing student, then return for the next mission in the five-part chain.
Complete Home Team Advantage, the fifth Corrupted Student mission.

achievements.description: All Surveillance Towers activated
achievements.summary: Activate every @mechanic{Surveillance Tower} across @loc{Manhattan}.

guide.context: The tower network becomes available during @npc{Yuri}'s early surveillance mission. Restoring towers uncovers the map and reveals nearby activity icons.

steps.text: Finish @npc{Yuri}'s early surveillance-tower mission to enable the city network.
Visit every tower icon, interact with its console, and match both waveform controls.
Check all nine districts and confirm that no inactive @mechanic{Surveillance Tower} icon remains.

achievements.description: Reach the Spectacular score threshold in one Bomb-type Taskmaster Challenge
achievements.summary: Reach the @mechanic{Spectacular} score threshold in one Bomb-type @mechanic{Taskmaster Challenge}.

guide.context: Bomb Challenges reward speed and rapid transitions between targets. Only one of the four Bomb locations needs a @mechanic{Spectacular} rating.

steps.text: Open the map, select a qualifying challenge, and preview its score thresholds before starting.
Reach the @mechanic{Spectacular} score threshold in one Bomb-type @mechanic{Taskmaster Challenge}.
Complete the run and wait for the results screen to record the required rating.

achievements.description: Reach the Spectacular score threshold in one Combat-type Taskmaster Challenge
achievements.summary: Reach the @mechanic{Spectacular} score threshold in one Combat-type @mechanic{Taskmaster Challenge}.

guide.context: Combat Challenge scoring favors fast defeats and uninterrupted multipliers. Only one of the four Combat locations needs a @mechanic{Spectacular} rating.

steps.text: Open the map, select a qualifying challenge, and preview its score thresholds before starting.
Reach the @mechanic{Spectacular} score threshold in one Combat-type @mechanic{Taskmaster Challenge}.
Complete the run and wait for the results screen to record the required rating.

achievements.description: Reach the Spectacular score threshold in one Stealth-type Taskmaster Challenge
achievements.summary: Reach the @mechanic{Spectacular} score threshold in one Stealth-type @mechanic{Taskmaster Challenge}.

guide.context: Stealth Challenge scoring rewards chained takedowns. Scan first to confirm that an enemy is marked Safe before using a quick Web Strike Takedown.

steps.text: Open the map, select a qualifying challenge, and preview its score thresholds before starting.
Reach the @mechanic{Spectacular} score threshold in one Stealth-type @mechanic{Taskmaster Challenge}.
Complete the run and wait for the results screen to record the required rating.

achievements.description: Reach the Spectacular score threshold in one Drone-type Taskmaster Challenge
achievements.summary: Reach the @mechanic{Spectacular} score threshold in one Drone-type @mechanic{Taskmaster Challenge}.

guide.context: Drone Challenges are time-focused. Release near the end of a swing and use Point Launch or Web Zip to recover speed between camera gates.

steps.text: Open the map, select a qualifying challenge, and preview its score thresholds before starting.
Reach the @mechanic{Spectacular} score threshold in one Drone-type @mechanic{Taskmaster Challenge}.
Complete the run and wait for the results screen to record the required rating.

achievements.description: Complete all 16 Taskmaster Challenges with at least an Amazing rating
achievements.summary: Complete all 16 @mechanic{Taskmaster Challenges} with at least an @mechanic{Amazing} rating.

guide.context: The set contains four Bomb, four Combat, four Stealth, and four Drone challenges. An @mechanic{Amazing} rating is enough for each completion.

steps.text: Complete the first @mechanic{Taskmaster Challenge} and continue the story until all challenge icons are available.
Finish all four Bomb, four Combat, four Stealth, and four Drone challenges with at least an @mechanic{Amazing} rating.
Check the map and confirm that all 16 challenge result cards record @mechanic{Amazing} or better.

achievements.description: Complete all Research Stations
achievements.summary: Complete all 17 @mechanic{Research Stations}, including the final @loc{Upper West Side} station.

guide.context: A station shows a green check only after its mini-mission is finished; two green arrows indicate fast travel but not completion. The last @loc{Upper West Side} station appears only after the other 16.

steps.text: After Harry's @mechanic{Research Stations} appear on the map, enter a station and interact with its display to start its mini-mission.
Follow the station's waypoints and objective until its map icon changes to a green check, then repeat for the other visible stations.
After completing 16 stations, finish the newly revealed seventeenth station in @loc{Upper West Side}.

achievements.description: Complete Act 1 of the main story
achievements.summary: Complete Act 1 of the main story.

guide.context: Finish And the Award Goes To...; its closing checkpoint is also the automatic Act 1 milestone.

steps.text: Complete the base story through And the Award Goes To....
Finish the mission's closing sequence so the Act 1 checkpoint registers.

achievements.description: Complete Act 2 of the main story
achievements.summary: Complete Act 2 of the main story.

guide.context: Finish Out of the Frying Pan...; its closing checkpoint is also the automatic Act 2 milestone.

steps.text: Complete the base story through Out of the Frying Pan....
Finish the mission's closing sequence so the Act 2 checkpoint registers.

achievements.description: Complete Act 3 of the main story
achievements.summary: Complete Act 3 of the main story.

guide.context: This automatic Act 3 milestone registers after completing Pax in Bello. The completed save then returns to @loc{Manhattan} free roam.

steps.text: Complete every base-story mission through Pax in Bello.
Finish the final sequence and continue until the completed save returns to free roam.

achievements.description: Craft 15 Upgrades
achievements.summary: Buy 15 gadget upgrade nodes; Suit Mods do not count.

guide.context: Open a gadget's detail panel to see its upgrade nodes. Suit Mods are a separate category and never advance this counter.

steps.text: Earn activity tokens, then open the Gadgets menu; do not count purchases in Suit Mods.
Buy upgrade nodes across any gadgets until the fifteenth gadget upgrade is purchased.

achievements.description: Defeat Wilson Fisk during the opening story mission
achievements.summary: Defeat @npc{Wilson Fisk} during the opening story mission.

guide.context: @npc{Fisk} is the opening boss. Destroy the room's turrets, web @npc{Fisk} until he is vulnerable, attack him, and clear his reinforcements between phases.

steps.text: Start the base campaign and fight through @npc{Fisk} Tower until @npc{Wilson Fisk}'s opening boss encounter begins.
Destroy the turrets, web @npc{Fisk} before attacking, clear his reinforcements, and defeat him.

achievements.description: Defeat Martin Li during the main story
achievements.summary: Defeat @npc{Martin Li} during the main story.

guide.context: During the final @npc{Martin Li} encounter, dodge until Li and his summoned demon tire, then use the attack prompt; thrown objects shorten the waiting phase.

steps.text: Advance Act 3 to the third and final @npc{Martin Li} encounter.
Dodge until Li and his demon tire, then attack during each opening until Li is defeated.

achievements.description: Defeat Electro and Vulture during the main story
achievements.summary: Defeat @npc{Electro} and @npc{Vulture} during the main story.

guide.context: Web @npc{Electro} before attacking and web his generators when they power up. Dodge @npc{Vulture}'s rush, then counterattack during his recovery.

steps.text: Advance the base story to the combined @npc{Electro} and @npc{Vulture} boss encounter.
Web @npc{Electro} and his generators, dodge @npc{Vulture}'s rushes, and defeat both bosses.

achievements.description: Defeat Scorpion and Rhino during the main story
achievements.summary: Defeat @npc{Scorpion} and @npc{Rhino} during the main story.

guide.context: Lure @npc{Rhino} into environmental hazards and pull objects onto him to create openings. When @npc{Scorpion} joins, eliminate him first to remove the ranged pressure.

steps.text: Advance the base story to the combined @npc{Scorpion} and @npc{Rhino} boss encounter.
Use environmental hazards to stun @npc{Rhino}, eliminate @npc{Scorpion} when he joins, and then finish @npc{Rhino}.

achievements.description: Complete the Tombstone side-mission chain and defeat Tombstone
achievements.summary: Complete the @npc{Tombstone} side-mission chain and defeat @npc{Tombstone}.

guide.context: The three-part chain starts outside @loc{Octavius Industries} in @loc{Greenwich}: On the Move, What's He Building in There..., and Let's Get Ready To....

steps.text: After @npc{Tombstone} appears in Act 2, go outside @loc{Octavius Industries} in @loc{Greenwich} and start @npc{Tombstone}: On the Move.
Complete On the Move, What's He Building in There..., and Let's Get Ready To... in sequence.
Use the counter-drug opening and thrown objects to stun and defeat @npc{Tombstone}.

achievements.description: Defeat Shocker during the bank encounter
achievements.summary: Defeat @npc{Shocker} during the bank encounter.

guide.context: @npc{Shocker} lowers his shield after large blast attacks. Dodge until that opening, throw an environmental object, and attack before the shield returns.

steps.text: Advance the base story to @npc{Shocker}'s bank boss encounter.
Dodge @npc{Shocker}'s blasts, attack while his shield is down, and pull down the chandelier in the final phase.

achievements.description: Disturb 500 rooftop pigeon flocks while traversing Manhattan
achievements.summary: Disturb 500 rooftop pigeon flocks while swinging close to @loc{Manhattan}'s rooftops.

guide.context: Only rooftop flocks count. Swinging low over roofs scatters them naturally, so sustained low traversal is faster than street-level swinging.

steps.text: Swing just above @loc{Manhattan}'s rooftops, where pigeon flocks spawn in Spider-Man's path.
Pass close enough to scatter each flock and keep using low rooftop routes.
Continue until 500 separate rooftop flocks have scattered.

achievements.description: Complete a level 1 Traversal Benchmark
achievements.summary: Raise any @mechanic{Traversal Benchmark} from level 1 to level 2.

guide.context: The pause menu's @mechanic{Benchmarks} page marks eight Traversal entries with a blue runner. Any one entry moving from level 1 to level 2 satisfies this achievement.

steps.text: Open the pause menu and select @mechanic{Benchmarks} to compare the current Traversal and Combat counters.
Choose one qualifying action with a short remaining requirement and repeat that exact action.
Raise any @mechanic{Traversal Benchmark} from level 1 to level 2.

achievements.description: Complete a level 1 Combat Benchmark
achievements.summary: Raise any @mechanic{Combat Benchmark} from level 1 to level 2.

guide.context: The pause menu's @mechanic{Benchmarks} page marks 19 Combat entries with a green fist. Any one entry moving from level 1 to level 2 satisfies this achievement.

steps.text: Open the pause menu and select @mechanic{Benchmarks} to compare the current Traversal and Combat counters.
Choose one qualifying action with a short remaining requirement and repeat that exact action.
Raise any @mechanic{Combat Benchmark} from level 1 to level 2.

achievements.description: Complete Helping Howard and catch all 12 escaped pigeons
achievements.summary: Complete Helping Howard and catch all 12 escaped pigeons.

guide.context: Find Helping Howard in @loc{Chinatown} beside @loc{F.E.A.S.T.}; accepting it adds 12 pigeon icons after the local towers are active. Chase each bird until the dual-button catch prompt appears.

steps.text: Meet Howard beside @loc{F.E.A.S.T.} in @loc{Chinatown} and accept Helping Howard.
Activate the @mechanic{Surveillance Towers} so all 12 pigeon icons appear on the map.
Chase each marked bird and use the dual-button prompt at close range until all 12 are caught.

achievements.description: Use Trip Mines to pull 10 pairs of enemies into each other
achievements.summary: Use @item{Trip Mines} to pull 10 pairs of enemies into each other.

guide.context: The @loc{Harlem} @mechanic{Fisk Hideout} contains clustered enemies and can be replayed. A @item{Trip Mine} attached to an enemy must pull that enemy into a second enemy for one pair.

steps.text: Equip @item{Trip Mines} and replay the @loc{Harlem} @mechanic{Fisk Hideout}, where several enemies stand in close pairs.
Attach a @item{Trip Mine} to one enemy while a second enemy is directly opposite its beam.
Repeat until 10 separate mine activations pull two enemies into each other.

achievements.description: Complete all Side Missions
achievements.summary: Complete all 16 base-game Side Missions marked by blue diamonds.

guide.context: Only activities labeled Side Mission count; bases and collectibles do not. More blue-diamond missions appear as the story and earlier chains progress.

steps.text: Finish the base story so every remaining blue-diamond Side Mission can appear.
Open the Missions menu, select each unfinished activity labeled Side Mission, and complete its closing objective.
Continue until all 16 Side Missions are marked complete; bases and collectibles are not part of this count.

achievements.description: Craft your first Upgrade
achievements.summary: Purchase the first upgrade node for any gadget.

guide.context: Gadget upgrades cost activity tokens and become available as gadgets unlock. The first purchased node on any gadget is enough.

steps.text: Unlock any gadget upgrade and earn the tokens shown on its first available node.
Open that gadget's detail panel and purchase the first upgrade node.

achievements.description: Perfect Dodge 10 attacks
achievements.summary: Purchase @mechanic{Perfect Dodge}, then perform 10 dodges when Spider-Sense turns blue.

guide.context: @mechanic{Perfect Dodge} is a Defender-tree skill. The dodge counts only when the Spider-Sense indicator has changed from white to blue.

steps.text: Open the Defender tree, purchase @mechanic{Perfect Dodge}, and enter any combat encounter.
Wait for the Spider-Sense indicator to turn blue, then dodge the incoming attack.
Perform 10 blue-window @mechanic{Perfect Dodge}s.

achievements.description: Complete 10 Vehicle Takedowns
achievements.summary: Complete 10 @mechanic{Vehicle Takedowns} during crime car chases.

guide.context: @mechanic{Vehicle Takedowns} occur in car-chase crimes. Districts with unfinished Thug Crime counters are useful places to scan for more chases.

steps.text: Choose a district with an unfinished crime counter, then swing through it while repeatedly scanning for red crime alerts.
Complete 10 @mechanic{Vehicle Takedowns} during crime car chases.
Hover over the district and confirm that the relevant crime or takedown counter has reached its target.

achievements.description: Visit Ben Parker’s grave in northwest Harlem’s cemetery and use its interaction prompt
achievements.summary: Visit @npc{Ben Parker}’s grave in northwest @loc{Harlem}’s cemetery and use its interaction prompt.

guide.context: @npc{Ben Parker}'s grave has no normal activity marker. It lies in the cemetery at @loc{Harlem}'s northwest corner and becomes easier to identify with the scanner.

steps.text: Travel to the cemetery in the northwest corner of @loc{Harlem}.
Use the scanner among the graves to identify @npc{Ben Parker}'s highlighted headstone.
Stand at the headstone and use the Pay Respects interaction prompt.

achievements.description: Perch atop Avengers Tower
achievements.summary: Climb @loc{Avengers Tower} in the @loc{Upper East Side} and perch on a red light at its highest point.

guide.context: @loc{Avengers Tower} stands east of Central Park in the @loc{Upper East Side}. The unlock requires the highest red aircraft light, not merely the roof.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{Avengers Tower} east of Central Park in the @loc{Upper East Side} and climb to the roof.
Climb onto the tower's highest red aircraft light.
Perch on that light for several seconds until the unlock registers.

achievements.description: Photograph all Landmarks on the Map
achievements.summary: Photograph all 47 landmarks marked across @loc{Manhattan}.

guide.context: A landmark photo counts when the camera reticle turns green and the subject is unobscured. Completed landmark icons turn gray.

steps.text: Activate the relevant @mechanic{Surveillance Towers} to reveal the collection icons on the map.
Photograph all 47 landmarks marked across @loc{Manhattan}.
Open the district map and confirm that the stated collection total has been recorded.

achievements.description: Ride the Subway 5 times
achievements.summary: Use fast travel five times to trigger five subway rides.

guide.context: Fast travel unlocks through story progress. Each use shows a subway cutscene and advances the counter once.

steps.text: Advance the base story until fast travel is enabled, then open the map.
Fast travel to any unlocked destination and allow the subway cutscene to begin.
Repeat fast travel until five subway cutscenes have played.

achievements.description: Chain 4 unique tricks before landing
achievements.summary: Perform four different aerial tricks in one jump before touching the ground.

guide.context: The Air Tricks Webslinger skill is required. A long drop from @loc{Avengers Tower} provides enough airtime to change stick directions four times.

steps.text: Open the Webslinger tree, purchase Air Tricks, then jump from @loc{Avengers Tower} or another tall building.
Hold the trick input in midair and change the movement-stick direction for four distinct tricks.
Complete all four tricks in the same fall before Spider-Man lands or begins swinging.

achievements.description: Wear five different Spider-Man suits
achievements.summary: Equip five different purchased Spider-Man suits.

guide.context: The Suits menu starts with several choices, but each of five distinct suits must be equipped at least once; simply owning them is insufficient.

steps.text: Unlock and purchase at least five suits with levels and activity tokens.
Open Suits and equip five distinct purchased suits, changing away from each one before selecting the next.

achievements.description: Perform 75 Stealth Takedowns
achievements.summary: Perform 75 Stealth or @mechanic{Perch Takedowns} without alerting the target first.

guide.context: Both ranged @mechanic{Stealth Takedowns} and overhead @mechanic{Perch Takedowns} count. Enemy bases and stealth challenges provide repeatable targets.

steps.text: Enter an enemy base or Stealth Challenge while the targets remain unaware of Spider-Man.
Use ranged @mechanic{Stealth Takedowns} on isolated targets or @mechanic{Perch Takedowns} from above.
Continue across stealth encounters until 75 takedowns have been recorded.

achievements.description: Collect 5 Backpacks
achievements.summary: Collect any five @item{backpacks} after their map icons become available.

guide.context: Backpacks appear early in the base campaign. Activating the local @mechanic{Surveillance Tower} reveals their icons and makes this a quick early unlock.

steps.text: Activate the relevant @mechanic{Surveillance Towers} to reveal the collection icons on the map.
Collect any five @item{backpacks} after their map icons become available.
Open the district map and confirm that the stated collection total has been recorded.

achievements.description: Greet 10 citizens
achievements.summary: Approach pedestrians at street level and use the interaction prompt to greet 10 citizens.

guide.context: Eligible pedestrians show an interaction prompt when Spider-Man walks near them at street level; high-fives and ordinary greetings both count.

steps.text: Land on a busy @loc{Manhattan} street and walk close to pedestrians until an interaction prompt appears.
Use the prompt to greet or high-five the nearby citizen once.
Move to new pedestrians and repeat until 10 greetings have registered.

achievements.description: Collect a Black Cat collectible
achievements.summary: Complete any one of the 12 @npc{Black Cat} Stakeouts.

guide.context: @npc{Black Cat} Stakeouts unlock during the base story and appear as cat-face icons after the local tower is active.

steps.text: Activate the relevant @mechanic{Surveillance Towers} to reveal the collection icons on the map.
Complete any one of the 12 @npc{Black Cat} Stakeouts.
Open the district map and confirm that the stated collection total has been recorded.

achievements.description: Complete every Spectrograph and Circuit Project in Otto’s lab
achievements.summary: Complete every Spectrograph and Circuit Project in Otto’s lab.

guide.context: @loc{Octavius Industries} in @loc{Greenwich} is a fast-travel point. The lab holds 10 @mechanic{Spectrograph projects} on the left and 10 @mechanic{Circuit projects} on the right; all are available after the story.

steps.text: Fast travel to @loc{Octavius Industries} in @loc{Greenwich} after finishing the story so every optional project is available.
Use the left workstation and solve all 10 @mechanic{Spectrograph projects}.
Use the right workstation and solve all 10 @mechanic{Circuit projects}.

achievements.description: Complete all objectives in a base
achievements.summary: Clear an enemy base after completing both optional objectives shown on its map card.

guide.context: Every base map card lists two optional objectives. Both must be fulfilled during the same successful base clear, before the last wave ends.

steps.text: Hover over an enemy-base icon and choose a base whose two displayed bonus objectives suit the equipped gadgets.
Complete both displayed bonus objectives before defeating the final enemy wave.
Finish the base in the same attempt so its result card records both objectives.

achievements.description: Complete a New Game+ playthrough
achievements.summary: Finish every main-story mission in a @mechanic{New Game+} campaign.

guide.context: @mechanic{New Game+} transfers suits, skills, gadgets, and upgrades. Optional activities are unnecessary for the second story completion.

steps.text: Finish the base campaign and return to the save-selection screen.
Create @mechanic{New Game+} from the completed save and select @mechanic{Ultimate difficulty}.
Complete every main-story mission through the ending; optional activities may be skipped.

achievements.description: Complete a playthrough on Ultimate difficulty
achievements.summary: Finish every main-story mission on @mechanic{Ultimate difficulty}.

guide.context: @mechanic{Ultimate difficulty} can be selected for @mechanic{New Game+}. Starting that mode from the completed save combines this requirement with One More Time.

steps.text: Finish the base campaign and return to the save-selection screen.
Create @mechanic{New Game+} from the completed save and select @mechanic{Ultimate difficulty}.
Complete every main-story mission through the ending; optional activities may be skipped.

achievements.description: 100% Complete CTNS: The Heist
achievements.summary: Reach 100% in The Heist by finishing its story, nine @item{artworks}, @npc{Screwball} challenges, and all Maggia crimes.

guide.context: The Heist uses a separate completion list from the base game. The @npc{Screwball} activities count at any rating for 100%, although Screwy requires @mechanic{Spectacular}.

steps.text: Open the relevant campaign map and inspect every district or episode completion category.
Reach 100% in The Heist by finishing its story, nine @item{artworks}, @npc{Screwball} challenges, and all Maggia crimes.
Complete the final unchecked activity and remain in the campaign until its completion percentage updates to 100%.

achievements.description: Get Spectacular or better in all Screwball Challenges
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{Spectacular} or better in every @mechanic{Screwball Challenge} in The Heist.

guide.context: The score preview shows the @mechanic{Spectacular} threshold. Fast finishes and well-timed @mechanic{Photobombs} add the points needed; @mechanic{Ultimate} ratings are unnecessary.

steps.text: Open the map, select a qualifying challenge, and preview its score thresholds before starting.
Earn @mechanic{Spectacular} or better in every @mechanic{Screwball Challenge} in The Heist.
Complete the run and wait for the results screen to record the required rating.

achievements.description: Complete The Maria, the first mission of The Heist
achievements.summary: Complete The Maria, the first mission of The Heist.

guide.context: The Maria is The Heist's opening mission and this milestone registers at its completion.

steps.text: Open The Heist campaign and start its first main mission, The Maria.
Finish every objective and closing scene in The Maria.

achievements.description: Complete the Black Cat subway chase in The Heist
achievements.summary: Complete the @npc{Black Cat} subway chase in The Heist.

guide.context: The subway chase is a mandatory part of The Heist's story after The Maria, so it cannot be missed while finishing the episode.

steps.text: Continue The Heist story after The Maria until the @npc{Black Cat} subway chase begins.
Keep pace with @npc{Black Cat} and finish the entire subway chase.

achievements.description: Complete Follow the Money, the finale of The Heist
achievements.summary: Complete Follow the Money, the finale of The Heist.

guide.context: Follow the Money is The Heist's final main mission; complete its ending sequence for the episode-story milestone.

steps.text: Continue The Heist story to its final main mission, Follow the Money.
Finish Follow the Money and its ending sequence.

achievements.description: Collect all nine stolen artworks and finish the follow-up at Greenwich Police Department
achievements.summary: Collect all nine stolen @item{artworks} and finish the follow-up at @loc{Greenwich Police Department}.

guide.context: Artwork locations produce a scanner beam, then a compass and distance indicator nearby. The collection is not finished until the post-collection police-station scene.

steps.text: Use The Heist map and scanner beams to locate all nine stolen @item{artworks}.
Follow the nearby compass and distance indicator to retrieve each artwork from its hiding place.
After the ninth artwork, visit @loc{Greenwich Police Department} and complete the collection's closing scene.

achievements.description: Complete all Crimes in a district
achievements.summary: Complete all five Maggia crimes in any one district during The Heist.

guide.context: The Heist adds five Maggia crimes to each applicable district. The district card records the count even though individual crimes appear dynamically.

steps.text: Choose a district with an unfinished crime counter, then swing through it while repeatedly scanning for red crime alerts.
Complete all five Maggia crimes in any one district during The Heist.
Hover over the district and confirm that the relevant crime or takedown counter has reached its target.

achievements.description: 100% complete CTNS: Turf Wars
achievements.summary: Reach 100% in Turf Wars by finishing its story, 25 crimes, four @mechanic{Hammerhead Fronts}, every @mechanic{Screwball Challenge}, and the challenge follow-up mission.

guide.context: Turf Wars uses a separate completion list. Its @npc{Screwball} finale appears only after every episode challenge has been cleared.

steps.text: Open the relevant campaign map and inspect every district or episode completion category.
Reach 100% in Turf Wars by finishing its story, 25 crimes, four @mechanic{Hammerhead Fronts}, every @mechanic{Screwball Challenge}, and the challenge follow-up mission.
Complete the final unchecked activity and remain in the campaign until its completion percentage updates to 100%.

achievements.description: Get Spectacular or better in all Screwball Challenges
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{Spectacular} or better in every @mechanic{Screwball Challenge} in Turf Wars.

guide.context: Turf Wars includes @npc{Screwball} Stealth Challenges with cameras. Web the cameras and isolate enemies before takedowns while also hitting @mechanic{Photobomb} windows.

steps.text: Open the map, select a qualifying challenge, and preview its score thresholds before starting.
Earn @mechanic{Spectacular} or better in every @mechanic{Screwball Challenge} in Turf Wars.
Complete the run and wait for the results screen to record the required rating.

achievements.description: Complete Blindsided, the first mission of Turf Wars
achievements.summary: Complete Blindsided, the first mission of Turf Wars.

guide.context: Blindsided is Turf Wars' opening mission and introduces shielded jetpack enemies; dodge under their rush and attack from behind.

steps.text: Open Turf Wars and start its first main mission, Blindsided.
Defeat the shielded jetpack enemies by dodging under their rushes and finish Blindsided.

achievements.description: Complete Lockup, including the NYPD convoy sequence, in Turf Wars
achievements.summary: Complete Lockup, including the NYPD convoy sequence, in Turf Wars.

guide.context: Lockup is a mandatory Turf Wars story mission after Blindsided; no @mechanic{Hammerhead Front}, district crime, or @npc{Screwball} rating is required for this milestone.

steps.text: Continue Turf Wars after Blindsided and start the main mission Lockup.
Protect the NYPD convoy through every chase and combat objective in Lockup.

achievements.description: Complete Bring the Hammer Down and defeat Hammerhead in Turf Wars
achievements.summary: Complete Bring the Hammer Down and defeat @npc{Hammerhead} in Turf Wars.

guide.context: Bring the Hammer Down is the Turf Wars finale. Protect the crime lords and web the cement truck when prompted before fighting @npc{Hammerhead}.

steps.text: Continue Turf Wars to its final main mission, Bring the Hammer Down.
Protect the crime lords, web the cement truck when prompted, and defeat @npc{Hammerhead}.

achievements.description: Clear all four Hammerhead Fronts in Turf Wars
achievements.summary: Clear all four @mechanic{Hammerhead Fronts} in Turf Wars.

guide.context: @mechanic{Hammerhead Fronts} begin in stealth and then force combat waves. Their four entrances are marked on the Turf Wars map.

steps.text: Open the Turf Wars map and enter each of the four marked @mechanic{Hammerhead Front} locations.
Use stealth for the opening section, then defeat every forced combat wave in each Front.
Finish all four Fronts and confirm that every Turf Wars base icon is complete.

achievements.description: Complete all Crimes in a district
achievements.summary: Complete all five Maggia crimes in any one district during Turf Wars.

guide.context: Turf Wars adds five Maggia crimes to each applicable district. Swing and scan inside one district until its DLC crime counter reaches five.

steps.text: Choose a district with an unfinished crime counter, then swing through it while repeatedly scanning for red crime alerts.
Complete all five Maggia crimes in any one district during Turf Wars.
Hover over the district and confirm that the relevant crime or takedown counter has reached its target.

achievements.description: 100% Complete CTNS: Silver Lining
achievements.summary: Reach 100% in Silver Lining by finishing its story, 20 crimes, four @mechanic{Olympus Hideouts}, nine @item{audiotapes}, every @mechanic{Screwball Challenge}, and the chase.

guide.context: Silver Lining keeps its own completion list. Both the audiotape follow-up and the @npc{Screwball} chase are required beyond the visible collectible and challenge sets.

steps.text: Open the relevant campaign map and inspect every district or episode completion category.
Reach 100% in Silver Lining by finishing its story, 20 crimes, four @mechanic{Olympus Hideouts}, nine @item{audiotapes}, every @mechanic{Screwball Challenge}, and the chase.
Complete the final unchecked activity and remain in the campaign until its completion percentage updates to 100%.

achievements.description: Get Spectacular or better in all Screwball Challenges
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{Spectacular} or better in every @mechanic{Screwball Challenge} in Silver Lining.

guide.context: The score preview shows the @mechanic{Spectacular} threshold. Prioritize speed and @mechanic{Photobomb} timing; @mechanic{Ultimate} ratings are not required.

steps.text: Open the map, select a qualifying challenge, and preview its score thresholds before starting.
Earn @mechanic{Spectacular} or better in every @mechanic{Screwball Challenge} in Silver Lining.
Complete the run and wait for the results screen to record the required rating.

achievements.description: Complete Old Friends, the first mission of Silver Lining
achievements.summary: Complete Old Friends, the first mission of Silver Lining.

guide.context: Old Friends is Silver Lining's opening mission and introduces the episode's jetpack opposition.

steps.text: Open Silver Lining and start its first main mission, Old Friends.
Finish every objective and closing checkpoint in Old Friends.

achievements.description: Complete all Screwball challenges, then finish the unlocked Screwball chase
achievements.summary: Complete all @npc{Screwball} challenges, then finish the unlocked @npc{Screwball} chase.

guide.context: @npc{Miles} contacts Spider-Man after all episode challenges are complete. During the resulting chase, every @mechanic{Photobomb} must be hit and every drone destroyed.

steps.text: Complete every Silver Lining @mechanic{Screwball Challenge}, then continue another activity until @npc{Miles} calls with @npc{Screwball}'s location.
Start the new @npc{Screwball} mission and keep pace during the chase.
Trigger every @mechanic{Photobomb} and destroy every drone before completing the chase.

achievements.description: Complete One Plus One Equals Win and defeat Hammerhead in Silver Lining
achievements.summary: Complete One Plus One Equals Win and defeat @npc{Hammerhead} in Silver Lining.

guide.context: Silver Lining concludes in One Plus One Equals Win. Web @npc{Hammerhead} to create openings and use his reinforcements to rebuild Focus.

steps.text: Continue Silver Lining to its final main mission, One Plus One Equals Win.
Web @npc{Hammerhead} to create attack openings and defeat him to finish the episode story.

achievements.description: Clear all four Olympus Hideouts and finish their follow-up mission in Silver Lining
achievements.summary: Clear all four @mechanic{Olympus Hideouts} and finish their follow-up mission in Silver Lining.

guide.context: @mechanic{Olympus Hideouts} begin at manhole entrances and contain six enemy waves. Scan after combat to find the highlighted supplies, then finish the follow-up mission after all four.

steps.text: Open the Silver Lining map and enter each of the four @mechanic{Olympus Hideouts} through its marked manhole.
Defeat all six waves in each hideout, scan for the highlighted supplies, and collect them.
After the fourth hideout, complete the new follow-up mission that appears.

achievements.description: Complete the "Scales of Justice" mission
achievements.summary: Collect all nine Silver Lining @item{audiotapes}, then complete the unlocked Scales of Justice mission.

guide.context: Audiotapes show as bright scanner beams and then a green search circle; yellow-and-black construction tape identifies the exact object.

steps.text: Use scanner beams and the green search circles to locate all nine @item{audiotapes} in Silver Lining.
Find the yellow-and-black construction tape inside each search area and pick up the recording.
After collecting the ninth recording, complete the unlocked Scales of Justice mission.

achievements.description: Max out one Benchmark type
achievements.summary: Max every tier of any one Traversal or @mechanic{Combat Benchmark}.

guide.context: The pause menu tracks 27 @mechanic{Benchmarks} across Traversal and Combat. Free Runner is a simple option because parkour vaults over street obstacles advance it.

steps.text: Open the pause menu and select @mechanic{Benchmarks} to compare the current Traversal and Combat counters.
Choose one qualifying action with a short remaining requirement and repeat that exact action.
Max every tier of any one Traversal or @mechanic{Combat Benchmark}.

achievements.description: Max out all Gadgets
achievements.summary: Purchase all 34 upgrade nodes across the eight base-game gadgets.

guide.context: The eight gadgets contain 34 upgrade nodes. Base and challenge bonus objectives can be replayed for additional tokens if the 100% route leaves a shortfall.

steps.text: Earn the tokens required for all eight gadgets, replaying base or challenge bonus objectives if necessary.
Open each gadget's detail panel and purchase all 34 upgrade nodes across the eight gadgets.

achievements.description: Achieve Ultimate on a Taskmaster Challenge
achievements.summary: Earn an @mechanic{Ultimate} rating in any one @mechanic{Taskmaster Challenge}.

guide.context: Bomb Challenge in Midtown is a practical @mechanic{Ultimate} target. Preview the three score thresholds before starting and choose whichever challenge best suits your route.

steps.text: Open the map, select a qualifying challenge, and preview its score thresholds before starting.
Earn an @mechanic{Ultimate} rating in any one @mechanic{Taskmaster Challenge}.
Complete the run and wait for the results screen to record the required rating.

achievements.description: Achieve a combo of 100
achievements.summary: Build a 100-hit combo without being hit or letting the combo timer expire.

guide.context: A base supplies enough enemies for a long combo. Dodge instead of trading hits and use quick web attacks to prevent the timer from dropping.

steps.text: Replay an enemy base so enough targets are available for a 100-hit combo.
Attack continuously, dodge every incoming strike, and use quick web attacks before the combo timer expires.
Reach 100 on the visible combo counter without taking a hit.

achievements.description: Complete any Enemy Base without taking damage
achievements.summary: Clear every wave of one enemy base without taking any damage.

guide.context: The lower @mechanic{Fisk Hideout} in @loc{Upper West Side} is a manageable six-wave choice. Damage in any wave invalidates the attempt, so restart the base immediately after a hit.

steps.text: Replay the lower @mechanic{Fisk Hideout} in @loc{Upper West Side} and restart immediately if Spider-Man takes damage.
Use stealth for the first wave, then dodge through the remaining five waves without losing any health.
Defeat the final enemy while still undamaged and wait for the base-clear result.
